```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("scoutR")
library("usethis")

k_func <- function(n) {
  x <- 0.5 - (0.2 / 6) * (n - 6)
  x <- pmin(0.5, pmax(0.3, x))
  (2/3) * x
}

m_func <- function(n) {
  0
}

events <- events(2023)
events_2026 <- events(2026)

all_matches_26 <- events(2026) |>
  filter(event_type_string != "Offseason") |>
  pull(key) |>
  map_dfr(event_matches)

all_matches <- events(2023) |>
  filter(event_type_string != "Offseason") |>
  pull(key) |>
  map_dfr(event_matches)

week1_events <- events|>
  filter(week == 1)|>
  pull(key)

quals_played <- all_matches|>
  filter(comp_level == "qm")|>
  #slice(1:75)|>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(blue1,blue2,blue3,red1,red2,red3), names_to = "position",
    values_to = "team")|>
  select(team,position,event_key,red_score,blue_score,key,match_number)|>
  group_by(team)|>
  count(team, name = "quals_played")

avg_score <- map_dfr(week1_events, event_matches)|>summarize(score = mean((red_score + blue_score)/2), auto_score = mean((red_autoPoints+blue_autoPoints)/2), endgame_score = mean((red_endGameChargeStationPoints+red_endGameParkPoints+blue_endGameChargeStationPoints+blue_endGameParkPoints)/2))|>mutate(teleop_score = score-auto_score-endgame_score)
  
matches <- events

match_data <- all_matches|>
  select(
    red1,red2,red3,blue1,blue2,blue3,match_number,event_key,red_score,blue_score,match_number,red_autoPoints,blue_autoPoints,red_endGameParkPoints,blue_endGameParkPoints,red_endGameChargeStationPoints,blue_endGameChargeStationPoints,red_foulPoints,blue_foulPoints
  )|>
  mutate(
    red_endGamePoints = red_endGameChargeStationPoints+red_endGameParkPoints,
    blue_endGamePoints = blue_endGameChargeStationPoints+blue_endGameParkPoints
  )|>
  select(
    -red_endGameChargeStationPoints,-red_endGameParkPoints,
    -blue_endGameChargeStationPoints,-blue_endGameParkPoints
  )|>
  mutate(
    red_teleopPoints = red_score-red_autoPoints-red_endGamePoints,
    blue_teleopPoints = blue_score-blue_autoPoints-blue_endGamePoints
  )|>
  mutate(
    red_score = red_score - red_foulPoints,
    blue_score = blue_score - blue_foulPoints
  )

epa <- tibble(
  team = quals_played$team, 
  epa = avg_score$score/3, 
  auto_epa = avg_score$auto_score/3,
  teleop_epa = avg_score$teleop_score/3,
  endgame_epa = avg_score$endgame_score/3,
  quals_played = 0
  )|>
  left_join(quals_played)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(match_data))) {
  match <- match_data[i, ]
  
  red_teams <- c(match$red1, match$red2, match$red3)
  blue_teams <- c(match$blue1, match$blue2, match$blue3)
  
  red_epa <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% red_teams]
  blue_epa <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% blue_teams]
  
  k_red <- k_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams])
  k_blue <- k_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams])
  
  m_red <- m_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams])
  m_blue <- m_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams])
  
  red_ex_score <- sum(red_epa)
  blue_ex_score <- sum(blue_epa)
  
  red_error <- match$red_score - red_ex_score
  blue_error <- match$blue_score - blue_ex_score
  
  red_epa_change <- k_red * (1 / (1 + m_red)) * ((red_error - m_red * blue_error) / 3)
  epa$epa[epa$team %in% red_teams] <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% red_teams] + red_epa_change
  
  blue_epa_change <- k_blue * (1 / (1 + m_blue)) * ((blue_error - m_blue * red_error) / 3)
  epa$epa[epa$team %in% blue_teams] <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% blue_teams] + blue_epa_change
  
  epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams] <- epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams] + 1
  epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams] <- epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams] + 1
}

events<-events(2023)|>filter(event_type_string!="Offseason")|>pull(key)
```

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("scoutR")
library("usethis")

k_func <- function(n) {
  x <- 0.5 - (0.2 / 6) * (n - 6)
  x <- pmin(0.5, pmax(0.3, x))
  (2/3) * x
}
m_func <- function(n) {
  0
}

all_matches <- events(2026) |>
  filter(event_type_string != "Offseason") |>
  pull(key) |>
  map_dfr(event_matches)

quals_played <- all_matches |>
  filter(comp_level == "qm") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(blue1, blue2, blue3, red1, red2, red3), names_to = "position",
    values_to = "team") |>
  select(team, position, event_key, red_score, blue_score, key, match_number) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  count(team, name = "quals_played")

avg_score <- all_matches |>
  filter(comp_level == "qm") |>
  summarize(
    score         = mean((red_score + blue_score) / 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    auto_score    = mean((red_totalAutoPoints + blue_totalAutoPoints) / 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    endgame_score = mean((red_endGameTowerPoints + blue_endGameTowerPoints) / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(teleop_score = score - auto_score - endgame_score)

match_data <- all_matches |>
  filter(comp_level == "qm") |>
  select(
    red1, red2, red3, blue1, blue2, blue3,
    match_number, event_key,
    red_score, blue_score,
    red_totalAutoPoints, blue_totalAutoPoints,
    red_endGameTowerPoints, blue_endGameTowerPoints,
    red_foulPoints, blue_foulPoints
  ) |>
  mutate(
    red_teleopPoints  = red_score  - red_totalAutoPoints  - red_endGameTowerPoints,
    blue_teleopPoints = blue_score - blue_totalAutoPoints - blue_endGameTowerPoints
  ) |>
  mutate(
    red_score  = red_score  - red_foulPoints,
    blue_score = blue_score - blue_foulPoints
  )

epa <- tibble(
  team          = quals_played$team,
  epa           = avg_score$score / 3,
  auto_epa      = avg_score$auto_score / 3,
  teleop_epa    = avg_score$teleop_score / 3,
  endgame_epa   = avg_score$endgame_score / 3,
  quals_played  = 0
) |>
  left_join(quals_played, by = "team", suffix = c("", "_counted")) |>
  select(-quals_played_counted)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(match_data))) {
  match <- match_data[i, ]
  
  red_teams  <- c(match$red1,  match$red2,  match$red3)
  blue_teams <- c(match$blue1, match$blue2, match$blue3)
  
  red_epa  <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% red_teams]
  blue_epa <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% blue_teams]
  
  k_red  <- k_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams])
  k_blue <- k_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams])
  
  m_red  <- m_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams])
  m_blue <- m_func(epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams])
  
  red_ex_score  <- sum(red_epa)
  blue_ex_score <- sum(blue_epa)
  
  red_error  <- match$red_score  - red_ex_score
  blue_error <- match$blue_score - blue_ex_score
  
  red_epa_change  <- k_red  * (1 / (1 + m_red))  * ((red_error  - m_red  * blue_error) / 3)
  blue_epa_change <- k_blue * (1 / (1 + m_blue)) * ((blue_error - m_blue * red_error)  / 3)
  
  epa$epa[epa$team %in% red_teams]  <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% red_teams]  + red_epa_change
  epa$epa[epa$team %in% blue_teams] <- epa$epa[epa$team %in% blue_teams] + blue_epa_change
  
  epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams]  <- epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% red_teams]  + 1
  epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams] <- epa$quals_played[epa$team %in% blue_teams] + 1
}
```
